extDescription.message: Shows observed browser API calls and signs of known services on the sites you allow.

coverageOff.message: Not observing: no scope selected. “Not detected” means “not observed in the accessible area during the period”.

host_access_needed.message: Site address is not available yet

vendorsEmpty.message: No matches observed. A missing match does not prove the absence of anti-fraud.

disclaimerNoVerdict.message: This extension only informs: it gives no verdict on site safety and does not block checks.

coverage_active_desc.message: Sensors were installed at document start. Workers, WebAssembly, CSS and server-side checks are not observed.

coverage_partial_desc.message: Only part of the document is observed: $DETAIL$. No findings in inaccessible areas means nothing.

coverage_late_start_desc.message: Sensors were installed after the page started running. Early calls may have been missed. Reload the page to analyse from the start.

coverage_late_start_active_tab_desc.message: Observing calls from activation until this document is replaced. Early calls may have been missed. To observe page load, choose “Always on this site”, then reload.

coverage_paused_desc.message: Observation is paused. The page keeps working.

coverage_paused_reload.message: To remove the sensors completely, reload the page.

coverage_unsupported_title.message: Observation is not available on this page

coverage_unsupported_desc.message: Built-in Chrome pages, the Web Store, other extensions and some special frames do not support observation.

coverage_unsupported_chrome_desc.message: This Chrome version is not supported ($VERSION$). Observation is unavailable.

coverage_no_access_desc.message: No access to $HOST$. The absence of observations means nothing. Choose an observation level to start.

coverage_revoked_desc.message: Access to $HOST$ was revoked. No new data is collected. Reload the page to remove the sensors completely.

coverage_degraded_desc.message: The event limit was exceeded: some data was dropped ($DROPPED$). This period cannot be treated as fully observed.

coverage_context_changed.message: Context changed: showing the report for $HOST$.

coverage_managed_desc.message: Some settings are managed by your organisation.

coverage_blind_spots_desc.message: Workers, WebAssembly, declarative CSS, Math computations, WebGL parameter queries (getParameter), the DNS resolver, TLS and server-side anti-fraud are not observed by this extension. The extension can be noticed by the site.

coverage_flag_hook_failed.message: sensors reported an installation limitation; diagnostics are page-controlled

coverage_flag_channel_gap.message: page channel gap or conflict; data is page-controlled

coverage_flag_truncated.message: details truncated due to the memory limit

coverage_flag_protocol_mismatch.message: sensor version is outdated, reload the page

coverage_flag_descriptor_nonconfigurable.message: some APIs cannot be observed: protected descriptors

coverage_flag_bridge_ring_overflow.message: transfer buffer overflowed, some data was lost

coverage_flag_budget_exceeded.message: document observation data limit exceeded; some details were not retained

state_no_report_desc.message: There are no observations for this document yet. If the page was opened before observation was enabled, reload it.

state_sw_unavailable_desc.message: The extension background process did not answer. Close and reopen this window; if the error persists, restart the extension.

empty_no_findings.message: No findings in the observed area for this period

empty_no_findings_hint.message: This is not a site safety assessment. Check the observed area above.

techniques_none.message: No techniques were observed in the accessible area.

card_api_use_canvas_text.message: Canvas text measurement or drawing calls — $COUNT$

card_api_use_audio_graph.message: Web Audio: oscillator and compressor creation, offline rendering — $COUNT$

card_api_use_attempt_only.message: Attempt only: the call threw, no result was returned to the page

card_api_use_generic_note.message: An API call by itself is ordinary and does not prove tracking.

card_note_webgl.message: Games and graphics applications query WebGL parameters to choose a rendering mode; some engines read GPU details to work around driver bugs.

card_note_audio.message: Audio editors, synthesizers and visualizers use offline rendering and audio data reads.

card_note_permissions.message: Sites check permissions to avoid unnecessary prompts; the extension does not store the results.

card_note_environment.message: Compatibility checks, responsive layouts and analytics read browser and screen properties; the extension does not store the values.

card_note_geometry.message: Layout code, tables and tooltips read element sizes all the time.

card_api_use_purpose.message: In general this mechanism can be used to recognise a browser.

card_purpose_local_probe.message: In general such a probe can be used to discover local services and the environment.

card_purpose_dns.message: In general such a series can be used to test the DNS resolver.

card_fp_generic.message: The call sequence looks like fingerprint construction

card_fp_canvas_sequence.message: A series of reads after drawing text looks like fingerprint construction

card_fp_math_sequence.message: A series of numeric checks looks like a known pattern

card_fp_webgl_probe.message: A series of queries about the graphics adapter and its capabilities looks like fingerprint construction

card_fp_audio_sequence.message: Offline processing of an oscillator signal followed by a data read looks like fingerprint construction

card_fp_permissions_breadth.message: Checking the state of many permission categories looks like collecting browser characteristics

card_fp_local_probe.message: A series of connection attempts to local addresses looks like a local-network probe

card_fp_dns_pattern.message: A series of requests to unique subdomains was observed; this happens in DNS tests. The resolver used is unknown to the extension.

card_fp_webrtc.message: The page used WebRTC. This mechanism can access network information.

card_fp_not_proven.message: Purpose, uniqueness and transmission of the result are not established by this observation.

card_fp_insufficient.message: Not enough data for a conclusion

card_vendor_purpose.message: Service purpose: $PURPOSE$. This is not a site safety assessment.

card_vendor_purpose_generic.message: bot protection, risk assessment or identification

card_vendor_match_weak_signal.message: integration element found (weak signal, may be spoofed by the page)

card_vendor_not_linked.message: A link between this service and other observations on the page is not established.

card_vendor_no_trust.message: A recognised service is not a site safety assessment and does not mean this service performs all checks.

card_vendor_match_weak_signal_network.message: request to a documented service address without an exact resource (weak signal)

card_vendor_request_only.message: A match means the browser received this resource. Execution of the service code and its server-side decisions were not observed.

vendors_coverage_limited.message: Only requests to hosts the extension can access in the current mode are recognized; requests to other hosts were not observed.

catalog_rule_counts.message: Recognition rules in this build: $ACTIVE$. Unverified catalog candidates (not used): $CANDIDATES$.

integrity_page_controlled.message: Data from the page context, may be spoofed

evidence_page_hook.message: API hook in the page context

attribution_sampled_stack.message: Call source from a stack sample (may be misleading)

detail_operations_hint.message: API names from the built-in list; values are not stored

operation_other.message: other values outside the built-in list

action_pause.message: Pause observation in the current document

action_reload.message: Reload to analyse from the start

export_preview_desc.message: Only the fields below are included (redacted). Full URLs, cookie values, API results and input contents are absent.

export_host_warning.message: The file contains the page host: $HOST$. Do not share it unnecessarily.

export_document_changed.message: The document changed. Open the preview again.

export_unavailable.message: Export unavailable: no access to the page or no report.

export_not_implemented.message: The background process does not support export preview yet.

mode_off_desc.message: Observation is off and no reports are created. Site access granted in the browser is kept until you revoke it.

mode_active_tab_desc.message: Observations after activation; early calls may have been missed. The network is not observed in this mode.

mode_site_desc.message: Reload the page to analyse from the start. Early calls in permitted documents on the next load; third-party network may be partially visible.

mode_all_desc.message: Broadest access, without promising full coverage of workers, DNS or server-side logic.

scope_permission_denied.message: Permission was not granted. The scope is unchanged.

scope_permission_granted_reload.message: Access granted. Reload the page to analyse from the start.

scope_site_host_unknown.message: The host of the current page is unknown: enable “Check from now on” first or enter the host in settings.

scope_host_invalid.message: Enter a host, for example example.com

scope_granted_all.message: Broad site access has been granted by the browser.

scope_applied_reload.message: Observation scope updated. Reload the page to start observing from page load.

onboarding_limits.message: The extension observes calls already being made without changing their results or blocking anything. It replaces some browser functions with wrappers: the site can notice this, and it adds execution time. Full coverage is not promised.

onboarding_no_server.message: The extension does not send analysis results and does not contact the developer's servers.

options_clear_session_desc.message: Deletes all document reports from session memory. Settings are kept.

options_clear_unavailable.message: This action is not available in this build yet.

inventory_session.message: Document reports live only in session memory (chrome.storage.session). After 10 minutes of inactivity, data is deleted on the next extension event, with checks at most once every 30 seconds, not at exactly 10 minutes. Closing the tab also triggers deletion; restarting the browser clears the session.

inventory_local.message: Settings (observation scope, chosen sites, disabled sensors and the last valid organization policy) stay in chrome.storage.local until you delete them.

inventory_never.message: Never stored: canvas pixels, audio, Math arguments and results, full URLs, cookie values, headers, request bodies, keystrokes and form text, IP addresses.

inventory_export.message: The export file contains only the fields shown in the preview, including the page host.

inventory_sync.message: Chrome account sync, disk and external servers are not used.

inventory_link.message: Full inventory: docs/data-inventory.md in the project repository.

counts_third_party_limited.message: third-party network is not observed with the current permissions

sources_none.message: No network events were received for this document.

sources_active_tab_unobserved.message: In “Check from now on” mode the network is not observed: the host list may be empty or incomplete, which does not mean there were no requests.

sources_no_access.message: This document is outside the chosen observation scope or access was revoked: its network is not observed.

sources_empty.message: Within the accessible scope Chrome registered no requests from this document.

sources_network_limited.message: Network events are visible only for permitted sites: requests to other hosts were not observed. The third-party count is a lower bound. WebSocket connections are not observed.

sources_network_scope.message: Shows document requests registered by Chrome. WebSocket connections, worker and service worker requests, in-memory cache hits, DNS, WebRTC and server-side logic are not observed.

sources_paused_gap.message: Requests during the pause were not counted: the numbers below are a lower bound.

sources_not_owner.message: A destination host does not identify the resource owner or processing purpose; no link to API calls is established.

sources_dropped.message: $N$ more destinations were not kept because of the limit.

relation_unknown.message: relation to the site not established

card_network_dns.message: Chrome registered requests to unique subdomains — $COUNT$

protect_req_intro.message: The extension drafts the request on this device. You send it yourself, from your e-mail or through the company’s form; the extension sends nothing.

protect_req_draft_badge.message: Draft: the template texts have not been reviewed by a lawyer

protect_req_not_legal_advice.message: This is not legal advice. The letter makes a request under a specific article and does not claim that the company broke the law.

protect_req_readonly.message: The Protection module is not running now. You can view, export and delete the log; new letters and status changes are available after you turn the module on in the settings.

protect_req_module_off.message: There is no log: the Protection module is off or its data was deleted.

protect_req_source_missing.message: The observation is no longer stored (it expired, was deleted or the tab was closed). You can prepare the letter without it.

protect_req_entity_invalid.message: Enter the company name (up to 128 characters).

protect_req_jurisdiction_hint.message: Choose the law that applies to you. The extension does not infer it.

protect_req_kind_access.message: Confirm the processing and provide a copy of the data

protect_req_kind_objection.message: Object to processing for marketing and profiling

protect_req_kind_opt_out.message: Opt out of the sale and sharing of data

protect_req_facts_hint.message: The company will learn the sites and dates in the ticked rows.

protect_req_identity_title.message: How the company will find your data

protect_req_identity_sender.message: By the address I send the letter from

protect_req_identity_typed.message: By another identifier that I type in

protect_req_identity_value_label.message: Identifier (for example, an e-mail address or a phone number)

protect_req_identity_warning.message: The company will receive this identifier. The extension does not save what you type and never fills it in itself.

protect_req_identity_required.message: Type the identifier or choose “By the address I send the letter from”.

protect_req_ru_formal_note.message: Under Federal Law 152-FZ a request needs identity document details and a signature. The extension neither asks for nor stores them.

protect_req_recipient_table.message: from the extension’s directory, checked on $DAY$

protect_req_recipient_unknown.message: The directory has no verified address for this company. Find it in its privacy policy and enter it.

protect_req_recipient_invalid.message: Check the address: Latin letters, digits and . _ + - before @, then the domain.

protect_req_gpc_mention.message: Mention the Global Privacy Control signal my browser sends

protect_req_copied.message: The text was copied to the clipboard.

protect_req_copy_failed.message: Automatic copying did not work: the text is selected, press Ctrl+C.

protect_req_portal_copied.message: The text was copied: paste it into the company’s form.

protect_req_mailto_long.message: The letter is long: the mail program gets a short text, and the full text is copied to the clipboard by the same click — paste it into the letter.

protect_req_mailto_shortened.message: The full text was copied to the clipboard: paste it into the letter instead of the short one.

protect_req_clipboard_note.message: Copied text goes to the system clipboard and to its history if it is on.

protect_req_mailto_note.message: If your mail program is web mail, the letter text is passed to it in the link address.

protect_req_saved.message: The request was added to the log as prepared. When you send the letter, mark it as sent.

protect_req_journal_storage.message: The log is stored only on this device, in the browser database, without encryption. The extension does not store your identifier, name or letter texts.

protect_req_status_extended.message: the company extended the deadline (marked on $DATE$)

protect_req_basis_gdpr_art_12_3.message: GDPR Art. 12(3): one month, extendable to three months

protect_req_basis_ccpa_opt_out.message: CCPA rules for opting out of sale: 15 business days (not confirmed)

protect_req_basis_pdl_152_art_20.message: 152-FZ Art. 20: 10 working days, extendable by 5 more

protect_req_deadline_note.message: The deadline is counted from the sending date you entered; the law counts it from receipt. Public holidays are not taken into account.

protect_req_retention.message: Unsent entries are deleted after 30 days, closed ones after 365 days, any entry 730 days after creation.

protect_req_ics.message: Add the deadline to the calendar (.ics)

protect_req_ics_desc.message: The file has only the deadline date and a reminder 3 days before, no sites or observations. Check the text and save the file.

protect_req_ics_summary.message: Response deadline of a personal data request

protect_req_ics_description.message: $LAW$: $KINDS$. The deadline is approximate: it is counted from the sending date you entered, public holidays are not taken into account.

protect_req_ics_alarm.message: In 3 days: response deadline of a personal data request

protect_req_delete_desc.message: The entry is deleted from this device. If the letter was already sent, deleting the entry does not cancel it.

protect_req_export_desc.message: The file has the log entries: laws, requests, companies, dates and statuses. The extension does not store your identifier, name or letter texts, so they are not in the file.

protect_req_export_facts_warning.message: The file will contain sites you visited and data receivers.

protect_req_clear_desc.message: All log entries are deleted from this device. Letters already sent are not cancelled.

protect_attr_kind_eval.message: code created while the page runs (eval, the Function constructor)

protect_attr_hint.message: The source comes from the call stack inside the page. The site can forge it: treat it as a hint, not proof.

protect_attr_nearest_frame.message: The nearest script in the call chain is shown. It may be a shared library rather than the one that started the send.

protect_attr_lim_ambiguous.message: Several scripts sent similar requests at almost the same time, so the source cannot be told apart.

protect_attr_lim_no_sample.message: The request did not go through the observed calls (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon).

protect_attr_lim_stack_unavailable.message: Call stack unavailable: the page changed the JavaScript error mechanism.

protect_password_listener.message: A script ($WHO$) listens to input in the password field. Listening is not reading; the extension never reads the password value.

protect_section_desc.message: Optional module, off by default. When on, it compares the text you type with outgoing requests (in memory only), can stop future requests according to your decisions, recognizes signs of session recording, keeps an optional local history and sends the GPC signal. Observation works the same with or without it.

protect_state_needs_consent.message: Suspended: the module’s terms changed, confirm your consent again

protect_state_needs_permission.message: Suspended: access to all sites or the request rules permission is missing

protect_disable_purge.message: Also delete the module’s history, decisions, excluded sites and request log

protect_disabled_notice.message: The module is off: blocking rules removed, comparison stopped. Wrappers on pages already open and the GPC property go away after they reload.

protect_disabled_notice_rules_pending.message: The module is off and comparison stopped. Blocking rules could not be removed: Chrome did not complete the rule change. They may keep applying until Protection is turned on again; the rules permission is kept so they can be removed then. Wrappers on pages already open and the GPC property go away after they reload.

protect_consent_intro.message: The module adds actions that change how the browser works. Read what changes and choose the features.

protect_consent_reads.message: Text you type into e-mail, phone and name fields. The extension’s script on the page derives fingerprints from it, and only those, never the text itself, go to the extension’s background part. They stay in memory for at most 15 minutes and are never written to disk. Neither the text nor the fingerprints pass through the page.

protect_consent_never.message: Passwords (including a field where the password is temporarily shown), bank card numbers and codes, one-time codes. In a document (frame) with a payment field, reading of its other fields is suspended; fields outside that frame, such as the e-mail on a checkout page whose card form is in an embedded frame, are read. If a site itself sends a password in a request, Chrome hands the whole request body to the extension: the extension drops fields named like passwords and stores nothing. A password sent outside such a named field cannot be told apart: that body is scanned in memory like any other and is not stored.

protect_consent_bodies.message: Outgoing request bodies of the tab where you type are scanned in memory (up to 64 KiB, for at most 10 seconds) and discarded. The evidence keeps only the recipient, field type, encoding and parameter name.

protect_consent_blocking.message: Following your decisions and the chosen mode, the extension can stop future requests to recipients. This may break sign-in, payment or checks on the site. A request already started cannot be stopped: “stopped” is shown only when a rule was in place before the request.

protect_consent_gpc.message: If you turn on GPC, the browser adds the Sec-GPC: 1 header to requests, and page scripts can read the navigator.globalPrivacyControl property. A site can notice the signal and is not obliged to honour it.

protect_consent_detectable.message: A site can notice the module through the GPC signal, stopped requests and wrappers of page functions: MutationObserver.observe (with input matching or session-recording detection) and, in some builds, also fetch, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon and addEventListener.

protect_consent_stored.message: On this device: module settings, your decisions (recipient, site, allow or block) and excluded sites. The “Who recognizes you” history only if you tick it below: by day, which recipients appeared on which sites, without page addresses or typed data. You can delete all of it in settings; Chrome should delete it when the extension is removed (not verified for this build).

protect_consent_permissions.message: Access to all sites (if not granted yet) and, for blocking and GPC, the request rules permission will be requested. Without them the module does not turn on.

protect_consent_limits.message: The module does not find every transfer. Bodies the site compresses or encrypts itself, WebSocket, WebTransport, requests from workers and the page’s service worker, input in multi-line fields and editable blocks, and data sent before it was turned on are not visible. No findings does not mean nothing was sent. This is not a site safety assessment.

protect_consent_no_server.message: The extension still makes no network requests of its own and sends nothing to the developer.

protect_feature_value_match.message: Compare what I type with outgoing requests

protect_feature_firewall.message: Block future requests according to my decisions

replay_level_none.message: No signs of session recording were observed in the covered area during this period

replay_level_signals_only.message: Isolated signs of session recording; not enough for a conclusion

replay_basis_behavior.message: The conclusion is based on page behavior, not on the content that was sent

replay_like_note.message: Event autocapture tools (product analytics) behave similarly

replay_masking_unconfirmed.message: Input masking: not confirmed. The extension cannot see the recording settings and does not decode the data that was sent

replay_masking_value_seen.message: A value you typed was found in a request to $SITE$ — see “Transfer of data you entered”

replay_signal_root_input_listeners.message: Page-wide subscriptions to keyboard input and to mouse movement or scrolling

replay_signal_root_mutation_observe.message: Observation of changes to the whole document (MutationObserver)

replay_signal_periodic.message: Periodic sends to $SITE$: up to $RUN$ in a row, 1–15 s apart

replay_signal_periodic_none.message: Periodic sends to another site, 1–15 s apart

replay_signal_vendor_resource.message: A resource matched an enabled rule of a session recording service: $VENDOR$

replay_signal_script_site.message: (scripts of $SITE$ — from a stack sample, data from the page context)

replay_vendor_rules_disabled.message: Session recording services are not recognized: the rules have not been verified on test pages yet

replay_disclaimer.message: This is not a safety assessment of the site. Session recording is used for analytics and support; a recognized service does not imply trust

replay_limit_no_script_attribution.message: Subscriptions are not linked to a specific script, so the conclusion stays at “looks like session recording” at most

replay_limit_element_listeners.message: Handlers on individual elements and fields are not counted, only at the window and document level

replay_limit_loaded_before_enable.message: The page was loaded before the feature was turned on: subscriptions are counted after a reload

replay_limit_websocket.message: Data sent over WebSocket is not visible

replay_limit_uncalibrated.message: Thresholds are not calibrated on real sites

replay_limit_listener_hook_off.message: Event subscriptions are not tracked in this build: the subscription sign is unavailable

replay_limit_mo_hook_off.message: MutationObserver is not tracked in this build: the document observation sign is unavailable

replay_limit_mo_options.message: MutationObserver options are not read: only the call on the document is counted

replay_limit_body_size.message: Body sizes are visible only in a tab where you type into a tracked field; other sends are counted without a size

replay_limit_cadence_reset.message: The extension's background part restarted: periodic sends are counted again from that point

replay_limit_hosts_truncated.message: There are more receivers than the report holds: those with the longest series are shown

replay_limit_workers.message: Requests from the page's background threads (workers) may not be counted

replay_limit_first_party.message: Sends to the site itself are not assessed: recording through the site's own domain cannot be told apart from its normal work

replay_receivers_more.message: $N$ more receivers — in the side panel

replay_level_help_none.message: no sign in the covered area; this does not mean there is no recording

replay_level_help_signals_only.message: isolated signs, but their combination was not observed

replay_level_help_replay_like.message: subscriptions to input and movement, observation of the document and periodic sends to another site (or a resource of a service by an enabled rule); low confidence

replay_level_help_replay_recording.message: the same signs are linked by a stack sample to scripts of the receiving site, or by a service rule to its send address; medium confidence, the content of the recording is not checked

protect_feature_history.message: Keep the local “Who recognizes you” history

protect_feature_gpc.message: Send the Global Privacy Control signal

protect_gpc_desc.message: When the signal is on, the extension adds the Sec-GPC: 1 header to requests and sets navigator.globalPrivacyControl to true for page scripts. It asks sites not to sell or share your personal data. The extension does not check whether a site honours the request.

protect_gpc_rule_error.message: The header rule could not be applied, so the signal may not be sent.

protect_gpc_restart_hint.message: If the request rules permission was granted just now, Chrome starts applying the rule after the browser restarts.

protect_gpc_rule_written.message: The Sec-GPC header rule is written to Chrome. The extension window on a page shows what was added to that page’s requests.

protect_gpc_off.message: The signal is off. To send it, tick “Send the Global Privacy Control signal” in the module section above.

protect_gpc_suspended.message: The module is suspended: the signal is not being sent now.

protect_gpc_excluded_sites.message: Sites excluded from the module: $COUNT$. The signal is not added to requests to them or from their pages; frames of other sites embedded in them may still get it (not verified).

protect_gpc_visibility.message: The signal makes your browser more noticeable: few Chrome users send it. The property is set by the extension, and a page can detect that.

protect_gpc_legal_us.message: United States: in some states (for example, California and Colorado) the law requires businesses it covers to treat this signal as an opt-out of the sale or sharing of personal data. The list of states and the conditions change.

protect_gpc_legal_eu.message: EU and UK: the law does not explicitly give this signal legal effect.

protect_gpc_legal_ru.message: Russia: the signal has no legal effect. It is a request to the site, not a demand.

protect_gpc_legal_note.message: This is not legal advice. The extension does not determine your jurisdiction.

protect_gpc_gaps.message: Not covered: WebSocket (the connection opens without the header); Web Workers and Service Workers (no property there); pages opened before you turned it on, until they reload; requests made by other extensions and by Chrome itself.

protect_gpc_site_on.message: GPC: the signal is sent to $SITE$

protect_gpc_site_excluded.message: GPC: $SITE$ is excluded from the module

protect_gpc_site_off.message: GPC: the signal is not being sent to $SITE$ now

protect_gpc_site_exclude.message: Don’t send on this site (exclude the site from the module)

protect_gpc_excluded_hint.message: You can bring the site back into the module in the module settings.

protect_gpc_nav_observed.message: The request for this page carried the Sec-GPC: 1 header (Chrome’s record of the outgoing request).

protect_gpc_nav_not_observed.message: The request for this page did not carry the Sec-GPC header.

protect_gpc_nav_unknown.message: No data on the request for this page: it may have come from the cache or loaded before the signal was on.

protect_gpc_nav_not_applicable.message: This page’s site or the site the navigation came from is excluded from the module: the signal does not apply to this request.

protect_gpc_counts.message: Requests checked: $WITH$ with the header, $WITHOUT$ without it.

protect_gpc_counts_lower_bound.message: These are lower bounds: requests made while the extension was inactive were not checked.

protect_gpc_reload_needed.message: The setting changed after the page loaded. The header already follows it; the property updates after a reload.

protect_gpc_sent_note.message: Added to the request is Chrome’s record of the outgoing request. The extension does not know whether the server received or honoured it. WebSocket connections open without the header.

protect_consent_ack.message: I understand the extension will read the text I type (except passwords, payment fields and one-time codes) in browser memory

protect_consent_ack_required.message: Tick the consent box to continue

protect_permission_denied.message: Chrome did not grant the permissions; the module is not on.

protect_preset_strict.message: Strict: after the first observed transfer of a typed value, block that recipient on the site right away; the first request has already been sent

protect_preset_normal.message: Normal: ask; until you decide, requests go out

protect_snooze_until.message: Marks hidden until $TIME$; rules keep working

protect_sites_desc.message: On these sites the module does not read fields, offer recipient decisions or record history; “everywhere” rules and strict-preset rules do not act here. Rules made for the site itself (by you or by strict mode) keep acting until you remove them. The browser adds no GPC signal to requests of these sites and their pages; frames of other sites embedded in them may still get it (not verified). Observation works as usual.

protect_sites_invalid.message: Enter a site name, for example bank.example.

protect_purge_confirm_desc.message: History, decisions, excluded sites, the request log, blocking rules and module settings will be deleted. Observation reports are not affected.

protect_reload_note.message: Changes apply to pages loaded after the change.

protect_org_policy.message: Your organization disabled the module with the ProtectModuleDisabled policy. It cannot be turned on here; you can delete its data.

protect_no_verdict.message: This is not a site safety assessment; a recognized service is not a sign of trust.

history_title.message: Who can recognize you across sites

history_intro.message: Third-party domains seen on several sites, and the mechanisms they could use to link your visits. Being seen on several sites is not recognition by itself.

history_off_desc.message: History is kept only after you turn it on in the Protection module settings and is stored only on this device.

history_mech_value_match.message: Data you typed (or its hash) was sent to it on $COUNT$ sites (as reported by Chrome)

history_mech_replay.message: Signs of session recording on $COUNT$ sites

history_mech_frame.message: APIs usable for fingerprinting were called in its embedded frames: $FAMILIES$ (sites: $COUNT$)

history_mech_requests.message: Pages made requests to it (request attempts reported by Chrome; some may have been stopped by blocking rules, yours or another extension's). Requests alone do not show whether it links visits: server-side matching cannot be observed

history_single_site.message: Domains seen on one site only: $COUNT$

history_empty.message: No domains seen on several sites were observed in the available scope during this period

history_since.message: History kept since $DATE$ (UTC days), retention $DAYS$ days

history_coverage_scope.message: Third-party requests and frames reach the history only where observation runs on all sites

history_coverage_truncated.message: History is incomplete: some older records were evicted by the storage limit

history_coverage_storage.message: History storage is unavailable: new records are not saved

history_coverage_reset.message: The browser removed the history data; history starts over

history_coverage_limited.message: Sites in this period where the network was observed only partly because of access limits: $COUNT$

history_gaps.message: Not visible: worker and WebSocket requests; server-side matching; redirects through intermediate domains; trackers under a site subdomain (CNAME); cookies; the source of API calls in the main document.

history_domain_only.message: The company is not identified; the domain is shown. Domains of one company are not merged.

history_disable_note.message: Turning history off deletes all its records

history_export_sites_warning.message: The file will contain a list of sites you visited. Do not share it unless necessary.

history_export_desc.message: The file contains exactly what is shown below: domains, days, mechanisms and counts, without page addresses or typed data. By default sites are replaced by numbers.

history_export_truncated.message: The file is incomplete: some records did not fit into 4 MiB.

history_this_site_empty.message: During this period no domains also seen on other sites were observed on this site.

history_this_site_unattributed.message: APIs usable for fingerprinting were called on this site; the source of the calls is not determined: $FAMILIES$

history_card_no_mechanisms.message: No linking mechanisms were observed in this period.

history_card_families.message: APIs in this domain's embedded frames (the source is known only down to the frame)

history_delete_desc.message: The records are deleted from this device. New observations will be added to the history again.

history_clear_confirm.message: Delete the whole “Who can recognize you” history?

history_clear_desc.message: All history records on this device will be deleted. Module settings, decisions and excluded sites are kept.

history_storage_note.message: The history is stored only on this device, in the browser database, without encryption.

history_retention_note.message: Records older than this are removed at the next extension event.

protect_reason_storage_unavailable.message: The module’s browser storage is unavailable: decisions and history may not be saved.

protect_reason_outcome_not_observed.message: Part of the module did not start; it will retry at the next extension event.

protect_reason_blocking_unavailable.message: Blocking rules and the GPC signal are not in effect now: Chrome did not apply the request rules. If the permission was just granted, they start working after the browser restarts.

protect_coverage_late_start.message: the page loaded before the module was turned on; earlier input was not checked

protect_coverage_paused.message: the site is excluded from the module

protect_coverage_unsupported.message: the module does not work here

protect_coverage_reload.message: the page loaded before the module was turned on: it does not work here until the page is reloaded

fw_alert_sent_before_submit.message: A request to $RECEIVER$ has already been sent — before the form was submitted. It contained what you entered: $DATA$.

fw_alert_stopped.message: A request to $RECEIVER$ was stopped by a firewall rule that was in place before the request.

fw_alert_unknown.message: A request to $RECEIVER$ contained what you entered: $DATA$. Whether it was sent was not observed by the extension.

fw_sent_note.message: A request that has been sent cannot be recalled: Chrome does not let an extension hold a request while you decide. The decision below applies to future requests.

fw_company_not_checked.message: not determined: service recognition is disabled in this build

fw_company_no_trust.message: A recognised service is not an assessment of whether the transfer is acceptable.

fw_sender_script_unknown.message: which script sent the request is not determined

fw_scope_once_desc.message: until it closes or you leave the site

fw_scope_no_vendor.message: Service recognition is off until signatures are verified, so the rule uses the receiver’s domain.

fw_action_allow_desc.message: The firewall will not stop these requests within the chosen scope and will not ask again.

fw_blocking_unavailable.message: Blocking is unavailable: Chrome has not granted the request rules permission. The firewall only reports events.

fw_resolved_blocked_title.message: Future page requests will be stopped

fw_resolved_blocked_desc.message: The rule for $RECEIVER$ applies from now on. It does not recall requests already sent and does not stop navigating to the address itself.

fw_resolved_error.message: The rule was not applied: requests to $RECEIVER$ are not stopped.

fw_resolved_stale.message: The details changed while you were deciding. Check them and choose again.

fw_counter_today.message: Stopped by rules today: at least $COUNT$

fw_counter_note.message: The number is a lower bound. The extension does not claim that a stopped request carried your data.

fw_strict_auto_notice.message: Strict mode: further requests to $RECEIVER$ on $SITE$ are now stopped. The request that contained what you entered started before this rule.

fw_strict_escalate.message: There are already block decisions for $RECEIVER$ on $COUNT$ sites. Block it everywhere?

fw_bypass.message: The rule did not apply to $COUNT$ requests to $RECEIVER$: they were sent.

fw_unsafe_receiver.message: $RECEIVER$ is a shared platform hosting other people’s sites: no rule is created for the whole domain.

fw_first_party.message: The firewall does not block a site’s requests to its own domain.

fw_rules_confirm_desc.message: The rules stop applying immediately. This cannot be undone.

badge_tooltip_firewall.message: Firewall: destinations awaiting a decision — $N$. Open the extension window to decide.

fw_receivers_hidden.message: $N$ more destinations await a decision. They are not shown: one prompt holds at most eight.

fw_moment_after_submit.message: when or after the form was submitted

fw_moment_unknown.message: timing relative to the form submission not determined

fw_sender_frame_unknown.message: a frame inside the page, the frame’s site not determined

fw_ev_match.message: Matched what you entered into a field of type “$FIELD$”

fw_ev_none.message: Request details are not available here: the transfer record is not in this page’s report.

fw_blocking_restart.message: Blocking starts working after the browser restarts: Chrome does not apply request rules right after the permission is granted. The decision is kept.

fw_blocking_degraded.message: Blocking rules are not fully applied right now: a new decision may not take effect.

fw_limit_reached.message: No rule was created for $RECEIVER$: the firewall rule limit is reached.

fw_resolved_dismissed.message: The notice is hidden. The transfer records stay in the list below.

fw_mode_strict_warning.message: Strict mode may stop sign-in, payment or CAPTCHA checks: protection services are not recognized in this build, so there are no exceptions for them.

fw_rules_search_invalid.message: Enter a domain: Latin letters, digits, dots and hyphens.

fw_rule_inactive_degraded.message: Chrome did not apply the rules

fw_feature_off.message: The firewall is turned off in the module features. Saved decisions are not in effect.

protect_leak_class_receiver_unknown.message: Found in a request to an address without a registrable domain: $CATEGORY$

protect_leak_class_opaque_after_input.message: Possible transfer: shortly after your input, a request to $RECEIVER$ had content that cannot be checked (compressed or binary)

protect_leak_count.message: Requests with this value: at least $N$

protect_leak_previous.message: Records about earlier pages of this tab: $N$

protect_where_body_form.message: Where: form field $NAME$ in the request body

protect_where_opaque.message: The request body cannot be read

protect_since_before_value.message: the request started before the extension received the value (within 10 s)

protect_delivery_sent.message: Sent: the browser sent the request

protect_delivery_stopped.message: Stopped: a blocking rule was in place before the request; the browser did not send it

protect_delivery_stopped_other.message: Stopped, not by a detect.expert rule

protect_limit_body_truncated.message: Only the first 64 KiB of the request body were checked.

protect_limit_name_plaintext.message: The name was found as plain text: the match may be coincidental.

protect_limit_previous_document.message: The value was entered on a previous page in this tab.

protect_limit_recent_request.message: The request started before the extension received the value.

protect_limit_entity.message: The party is determined by registrable domain: domains of one company count as different recipients.

protect_limit_payment_suspended.message: There is a payment field: in the document that contains it (the page or an embedded frame), reading other fields is suspended; fields outside that document are read.

protect_limit_body_opaque.message: The request body is compressed or binary: its content cannot be checked.

protect_limit_submit_unknown.message: The page where you typed the value changed without an observed form submission.

protect_limit_receiver_hosts_form.message: The recipient is the site of the embedded form where you typed the value.

protect_limit_budget_exceeded.message: The module’s memory limits on this tab were exceeded: some records, fingerprints of typed values or request bodies were dropped or not fully checked. What is shown is a lower bound.

protect_password_note.message: The extension never reads or compares passwords.

export_include_host.message: Include the page host in the export:

vendors_catalog_unavailable.message: The service catalog is disabled: service recognition was not performed.

limitation_page_controlled_evidence.message: These observations come from the page context and can be forged by the page.

limitation_purpose_unknown.message: The purpose of the API calls is unknown.

limitation_uniqueness_not_established.message: The uniqueness and stability of the results were not tested.

limitation_readback_attempted_failed.message: At least one read attempt threw an exception; this does not establish a successful read.

limitation_uncalibrated_threshold.message: Rule thresholds have not yet been calibrated against a corpus of examples.

limitation_coverage_incomplete.message: Observation coverage is incomplete; some calls may have been missed.

limitation_catalog_disabled.message: The service catalog is disabled; links between observations and vendors were not checked.

limitation_text_ops_undifferentiated.message: Text measurement and drawing are counted together; their separate counts are unknown.

limitation_no_time_window.message: Counters cover the document lifetime and do not show activity within a separate short interval.

limitation_argument_not_classified.message: Some call arguments were not classified: reading them could run page code.

limitation_hook_retired.message: After many calls, observation of this API was stopped to reduce overhead; the count shown is a minimum.

limitation_buffer_origin_unknown.message: It is not established that the audio buffer read was produced by the observed offline rendering.

limitation_permission_name_from_status.message: The permission category is known only when the page read the result's state; the result itself is not stored.

limitation_handshake_only.message: Only the connection handshake is visible; messages and closing are not observed.

limitation_outcome_not_observed.message: Request outcomes are not tracked: a connection error does not mean the port is closed, and the browser may have blocked the request.

limitation_no_causal_link.message: Timing overlap with other observations does not mean their results were sent in these requests.

limitation_resolver_unknown.message: Whether a DNS lookup happened and which resolver was used are unknown to the extension.

limitation_network_scope_limited.message: Network events are visible only for permitted sites; some requests were not observed.

alternative_high_volume_rendering.message: A large number of text operations can also occur during ordinary editing or chart rendering.

alternative_repeated_webgl_readback.message: Repeated WebGL pixel reads are typical for games and object picking.

coverage_flag_network_limited.message: network observations are limited by available permissions

coverage_flag_frames_inaccessible.message: some frames are inaccessible for observation

badge_tooltip_paused.message: Categories with findings before the pause: $N$. Observation is paused.

badge_tooltip_revoked.message: Access to this page was revoked: no new data is collected.

site_access_other.message: Other site permissions granted in Chrome: $N$.

site_removed_access_kept.message: Site $HOST$ is no longer observed, but Chrome kept access to it. You can revoke access in Chrome settings.

site_removed_all_sites_kept.message: Site $HOST$ removed from the list. Access to all sites is still granted — you can revoke it in this section.

all_sites_revoked.message: Access to all sites revoked. Reload open pages to remove the sensors completely.

scope_off_access_revoked.message: Observation is off and site access is revoked.

card_vendor_first_party.message: Vendor signature observed on an endpoint of the site's own domain

sensor_disabled_reason_both.message: in the extension settings and by your organization's policy

sensor_desc_environment.message: Reads of navigator, User-Agent Client Hints, screen, hardwareConcurrency, deviceMemory (DET-025, DET-026, DET-029, DET-032, DET-033).

options_sensors_desc.message: A disabled sensor is not installed on pages loaded after the change. On pages that are already open its data is no longer stored, and its hooks are removed only after the page is reloaded.

options_sensor_state_off_org.message: disabled by your organization's policy; cannot be changed here

options_sensors_org_policy.message: Some sensors are disabled by your organization's policy. An administrator can check the policy at chrome://policy.

options_sensors_policy_rejected.message: Your organization's policy contains rejected values: $COUNT$. They were not applied.

options_sensors_policy_lkg.message: The new organization policy is invalid, so the last valid settings remain in effect.

options_sensors_applied.message: Sensor settings saved. Open pages receive the change fully after they are reloaded.

confirm_clear_desc.message: Observations and findings for $HOST$ will be deleted from session memory. This cannot be undone. If observation continues, new calls will appear in the report again.

confirm_clear_session_desc.message: Reports of all documents in all tabs will be deleted from session memory. Settings and granted site access are kept. This cannot be undone.

export_unavailable_no_access.message: Export unavailable: no access to this page.
